events.title: Tupac Shakur Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac's music and message still resonate. We're looking back at the impact of a true hip-hop icon today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still unmatched, still inspiring. Join us as we celebrate the extraordinary talent of Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very happy birthday. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album brought us a timeless message. Its relevance endures.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Imagine There's No Heaven
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: An Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental classic – what's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal moment in their sound. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: John Lennon Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing, who would have been 86.

angles.name: A Voice For Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.
